summary: This is a foreign private issuer's Form 6-K furnishing a press release that announces a quarterly interim dividend of $0.10 per ordinary share, payable June 25, 2026 to holders of record June 11, 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of a regular dividend declaration by the board. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The registrant is Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A., and no special-situation event is present.
